name: Muroran (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Muroran city emblem in white: a broken ring of segments enclosing a stylised snowflake.
history: Municipal flag of Muroran, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 April 1936.

features.role: Muroran city emblem — a broken ring of segments enclosing a stylised snowflake
